description: Leo lifecycle hooks with shared Python behavior on Windows and POSIX.

hooks.commandWindows: python -c "import subprocess,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())/'scripts/leo_runtime.py'; sys.argv=[str(p),'session-start','--codex']; runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')"

python -c "import subprocess,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())/'scripts/leo_runtime.py'; sys.argv=[str(p),'session-start','--codex','--no-sync']; runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')"

python -c "import subprocess,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())/'scripts/leo_runtime.py'; sys.argv=[str(p),'pre-compact']; runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')"
